description: What each receiver needs from an IQ block. min_sample_rate_hz: below it the signal does not fit in the capture. min_duration_s: below it the receiver cannot work at all (one sync period / one packet). recommended_duration_s: long enough for the receiver's full output (identity + payload). bands_hz: where the receiver looks (informational; each receiver's own band check is authoritative). Used for the response's 'coverage' block and warnings; it never gates a receiver. Shared by the Python and C++ implementations.

pipeline.note: Measured on testdata (Phantom 4 capture, 61.44 MSps): below 16384 samples the 16384-point fine spectrogram cannot be formed; 16384-65536 samples (0.3-1 ms) run but the per-bin noise floor rests on too few frames and gives spurious detections; real decodes start near 131072 samples (2 ms). Blocks under min_samples are refused (status insufficient_input); under recommended_samples / recommended_duration_s a SHORT_BLOCK warning is added. Accumulate small blocks (2048, 4096, ...) with StreamAnalyzer first. 2^21 samples = 34.1 ms at 61.44 MSps covers one LTE/NR sync period with margin and one analog video field.

wifi.why: one OFDM PPDU (preamble 20 us) or one 802.11b PPDU (192 us preamble); every AP beacons once per 102.4 ms. Non-standard-clock links are searched in any band.

rc_link.why: a BLE advert is <= 376 us; a LoRa packet needs its 8-symbol preamble + header (SF7/125 kHz: ~12 ms; SF12: ~0.3 s).

dji.why: OcuSync video frames and RC hops repeat every few ms; DroneID bursts are reported roughly every 0.6 s (published reverse engineering, not measured here). 20 MHz video needs 30.72 MSps.

analog_vtx.why: the sync-tip fold needs tens of video lines (64 us each); a full picture needs one field (16.7 ms NTSC, 20 ms PAL).

jammer.why: the sweep must be wider than 10 MHz to be told from FSK / FM video, and the fold needs >= 8 sweep periods (300 Hz-120 kHz sweeps: 30 ms holds 8 periods of the slowest).

voice_fm.why: the carrier and deviation need ~10 ms of keying; CTCSS needs >= 0.3 s and DCS >= 0.35 s.

pmr_digital.why: a DMR burst is 27.5 ms (SYNC in its middle) and a TETRA timeslot 14.17 ms, so 30 ms holds a DMR SYNC and two TETRA slots (a synchronisation burst is not in every slot); one TETRA multiframe (1.02 s) always carries the BSCH; an NXDN frame is 40 ms (80 ms at 2400 sym/s).

digital_vtx.why: Herelink: the LTE PSS repeats every 5 ms and the fold needs several half-frames; blind OFDM numerology needs a few bursts.

lte.why: PSS every 5 ms (folded over half-frames); SSS needs both subframe 0 and 5 (10 ms). MIB/SIB are not decoded yet.

nr.why: SSBs repeat every 20 ms by default (initial access); combining several bursts improves the MIB. 30 kHz SSBs (n78) need 7.68 MSps.

gsm.why: FCCH repeats every 10 TDMA frames (46.15 ms) and SCH follows one frame later; BCCH system information needs the 235 ms 51-multiframe.

adsb.why: a Mode S frame is 64 or 120 us (8 MSps preferred); an airborne position needs an even/odd CPR pair within 10 s.

emitters.why: associates the drone receivers' bursts; no IQ of its own.

devices.why: reads decoded 802.11 frames; a device inventory needs at least one beacon interval.

cofdm.why: the 2 MHz COFDM mode needs >= 2.3 MSps; a TPS frame (68 symbols) lasts 17 ms (2K, 8 MHz) to 68 ms (2K at 2 MHz or 8K at 8 MHz), the CP fold needs >= 8 symbols
